item.title: Re: An SCP concept, my first one actually so I need green lighting
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Elevator Pitch: So the SCP is an area (currently affecting an appartamento in Moscow, plot twist is that the area is growing), that traps people within the area, it keeps its victims alive as it feeds on something. The more the victim spends inside the area the harder it is to escape as the reality changes and non-ecleudian spaces around them become more and more severe. The SCP lure people into itself with SCP-A and SCP-B. B is audio lures like screams of help and cats purring, A is treasures like important intel and money. The foundation used to send a lot of D-class into the affected area in order to collect A, the anomaly seemed to target the foundation specifically as the treasures more and more often became intel on GOIs and expensive amnestics. Now the expeditions are stopped indefinitely after the area started growing

Central Narrative: there is a long description and average exploration log, some addendums

Hook/Attention-Grabber: High danger level and unic containiment procedures recommending you to poison yourself to avoid the anomaly

Additional Notes: None
